title: THE PRESS DECK · CHEST LADDER + SWING · 45:00
vibe: GREEN · 45 MIN · HARD UPPER, CHEST FIRST, NO TREADMILL
why: Legs were loaded heavy on the clock yesterday, so today the lower body only hinges. Chest leads: a 2-4-6-8 floor press and hand-release push-up ladder, then swings paired with chest fly-to-press and rows, a 5-minute chest burner, and an anti-rotation close. Your own 2 mi stays yours; no treadmill on this card.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 5 MIN · SHOULDERS, SPINE, WRISTS
blocks.meta: ONE PASS · Moves Method Day A (press day)

items.name: Shoulder dislocates with a towel x10
Thoracic rotations x8/side
items.detail: on all fours, hand behind head

items.name: Scapular push-ups x10
items.detail: arms locked, only the shoulder blades move

items.name: Jefferson curl x6
items.detail: bodyweight, roll down one vertebra at a time

items.name: Wrist rocks x10 each way
items.detail: hands flat, rock forward and back

items.name: Two-hand swing x10 with a light bell, then double DB floor press 2x35 x8
items.detail: groove both patterns before the clock

blocks.text: Set up before the clock: 2x55 and 2x60 for floor press, 2x30 or 2x35 for fly-to-press, 2x60 for rows, 2x45 for the burner and renegade rows, the heaviest kettlebell on the rack for swings.

blocks.title: BLOCK A · LADDER 2-4-6-8 · 12:00 · FLOOR PRESS / HAND-RELEASE PUSH-UP
blocks.meta: 12:00 clock · climb 2, 4, 6, 8 then reset to 2 · rest only as needed · count rungs
blocks.format: ascending ladder, grind + bodyweight push (Neupert #92 2KBB 3 scheme)

items.name: A1 · Double DB floor press 2x55 → 2x60
items.detail: elbows 45 degrees, triceps touch the floor each rep, press and squeeze; start at 2x55, go to 2x60 for ladder 2 if crisp

items.name: A2 · Hand-release push-up
items.detail: chest to the floor, lift both hands off, then press; same reps as A1

blocks.text: One ladder = 20 press reps + 20 push-ups. Target 2 full ladders plus the 2 and 4 of a third (GREEN: 3 full ladders). Write the press load you finished on and the rungs completed.

blocks.title: BLOCK B · 5 ROUNDS · SWING / FLY-TO-PRESS / GORILLA ROW
blocks.meta: 5 ROUNDS · ~10:00 · rest only when the bells are down · Neupert #94 swing + push pairing

items.name: B1 · Two-hand kettlebell swing x12
items.detail: heaviest bell on the rack (24 kg or more if there is one; if nothing past 20 kg, swing the 70 lb dumbbell held by the head). Hips snap, arms stay loose

items.name: B2 · Double DB floor fly-to-press 2x30 → 2x35 x8
items.detail: WILDCARD: lower in a wide fly, soft elbows, then turn it into a press at the bottom and drive up

items.name: B3 · Gorilla row 2x60 x8/side
items.detail: both bells on the floor between the feet, hinge, row one while the other stays on the floor

blocks.text: Swings are the only leg work today: hard hips, no squatting them. If the fly-to-press shoulders feel pinchy, shorten the fly and keep the press.

blocks.title: BLOCK C · CHEST BURNER · 5:00
blocks.meta: 5 ROUNDS of 1:00 · 30 s work / 30 s work, no rest · push-up pyramid logic
blocks.format: alternating 30 s stations, glycolytic chest finisher

items.name: C1 · Close-grip DB floor press 2x45 · 30 s
items.detail: bells touching over the sternum, elbows tucked, triceps and inner chest

items.name: C2 · Plyo push-up (hands leave the floor) · 30 s
items.detail: drop to knees-up regular push-ups when the pop is gone, keep moving the whole 30 s

blocks.text: Count total press reps and total push-ups across the 5 minutes. This is the piece you are allowed to be ugly on.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 2 ROUNDS · 7 MIN
blocks.meta: 2 ROUNDS · rest 30 s between rounds · anti-rotation first

items.name: Renegade row 2x45 x6/side
items.detail: feet wide, hips dead still, pull the bell to the ribs

items.name: DB pullover 50 x10
items.detail: on the floor, slight knee bend, bell over the chest to behind the head, ribs down

items.name: Side plank with top-arm reach-under x8/side
items.detail: rotate under, open back up, hips high

items.name: Hollow hold 30 s
items.detail: low back glued down, arms by the ears if you can

blocks.text: Pullover: stop where the ribs start to flare. Record which renegade row side was weaker.

blocks.title: COOLDOWN · 3 MIN
blocks.meta: walk 1:00, doorway pec stretch 45 s/side, child's pose with reach 45 s
blocks.text: Record: press load you finished on, rungs in the 12:00 ladder, swing bell used, burner totals, RPE. Also still owed: yesterday's ANVIL loads, burner rounds and RPE.

timer.emomUnit: full ladders in the 12:00 press block
